objective: Close a provenance gap where byte-valid native-4K PNG/crop evidence could theoretically be re-sealed after the visual candidate changed, without a new Camera.Render. Bind scoreable render evidence to the exact persisted Unity scene/dependency/render-settings/capture-recipe candidate and invalidate stale receipts fail-closed.

commits.summary: Add fail-closed render-candidate freshness QA, candidate epoch/seal/invalidation receipts, active-scene/dependency/settings/recipe fingerprinting, and stale-receipt invalidation.
Add machine-readable render_candidate_freshness_contract.json with zero-point evidence policy and stale re-seal attack closure.

problemFound.description: Existing render provenance strongly bound capture/crop/manifest/receipt bytes, but byte integrity alone does not prove that those pixels correspond to the current visual candidate after scene, material/shader dependencies, project render settings, or formal capture/tonemap recipe changes.
problemFound.risk: A previously valid native-4K packet could remain byte-valid and be re-sealed without Camera.Render after a candidate mutation, allowing an obsolete image to be associated with a newer candidate.

candidateFingerprint: active persisted scene asset path + GUID + scene SHA-256
formal 4K capture/review/filmic/environment recipe source SHA-256 set
latest tracked candidate input/meta file modification UTC
freshCaptureBinding: manifest generatedUtc must be >= candidate mutation epoch and latest tracked input write UTC
continuousFailClosedPolicy: dirty active scene invalidates a live receipt
candidate digest or scene identity change invalidates a live receipt
missing/mismatched candidate seal invalidates a live receipt
capture older than candidate mutation/input write invalidates a live receipt
stale action rewrites render_capture_receipt.renderProducedByUnity=false so existing provenance/scoring gates fail

selfAudit.projectSettingsRepositoryState: Only ProjectVersion.txt is currently tracked under UnityProject/ProjectSettings. The freshness guard intentionally requires the live Unity project's ProjectSettings.asset, QualitySettings.asset and GraphicsSettings.asset at runtime; if Unity has not materialized them, the guard fails closed instead of pretending settings provenance is known.
